description: This file defines the 'digest' package, including the Digest type, functions for creating, parsing, and validating digest strings, and related constants and variables. It handles digest string formatting, validation, and verification logic.

classes.name: Digest
classes.description: Type representing a hex formatted digest string with algorithm prefix.

methods.name: NewDigest
methods.description: Creates a new Digest from an Algorithm and hash.Hash object.

methods.name: NewDigestFromBytes
methods.description: Creates a new Digest from algorithm and byte slice.

methods.name: NewDigestFromHex
methods.description: Deprecated. Creates a Digest from algorithm and hex string.

methods.name: NewDigestFromEncoded
methods.description: Creates a Digest from algorithm and encoded string.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a string into a validated Digest object.

methods.name: FromReader
methods.description: Generates a canonical digest from an io.Reader.

methods.name: FromBytes
methods.description: Generates a digest from byte slice.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Generates a digest from a string.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the digest's format and algorithm.

methods.name: Algorithm
methods.description: Returns the algorithm part of the digest.

methods.name: Verifier
methods.description: Returns a verifier object for stream validation.

methods.name: Encoded
methods.description: Returns the encoded part of the digest.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the digest.

methods.name: sepIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the separator ':' in the digest string.
